capabilities: : Display icons in notes via shortcodes.
: Assign icons to files and folders.
: Load external icon sets on demand.
extras: Supports custom SVG files, Devicon, Simple Icons, and Lucide icons; includes security measures to clean SVGs before rendering.
intentEvidence: I could not find a plugin that did it the way I wanted.
motivation: The author wanted a way to use their own custom SVG files in Obsidian without manual exporting.
problem: Existing plugins required manual file exporting or restricted icon sources, preventing users from easily using their own custom SVG designs.
summary: A plugin that allows users to define and use custom SVG, Devicon, Simple Icons, and Lucide icons in notes and the file explorer via shortcodes and settings.
